svg.text: The best energies at each cost, instance by instance
Every energy whose paper, or QMBL's own run, states what it cost in hours, on the 17 instances with at least two such rows.
Colour is the kind of number; filled marks can hold a record, hollow ones cannot.
record: −0.497694 (CNN-MPS), no cost stated, not drawn
exact: −0.503810 (ED), no cost stated, not drawn
exact: −0.560373 (ED), no cost stated, not drawn
record: −0.498963 (RBM + PP), no cost stated, not drawn
record: −0.496914 (CNN-MPS), no cost stated, not drawn
record: −0.766230 (ACE), no cost stated, not drawn
record: −0.496791 (mVMC + RBM), no cost stated, not drawn
record: −0.496380 (VMC), no cost stated, not drawn
record: −0.496799 (CNN-MPS), no cost stated, not drawn
Circles are GPU-hours, squares CPU core-hours (15 rows). For 13 rows the hours are devices × wall-clock, multiplied here. Labels marked QMBL
are QMBL's own reference runs; each instance's own figure names all of them. An exact energy marked "cost measured by QMBL" is placed at
what diagonalizing the instance cost QMBL, on 1 core of an AMD EPYC 7H12 64-Core Processor, with only particle number or Sz conserved.
